Maria S.: Heads-up — CI SAST (semgrep) flagged high-severity SQLi in auth-service on branch feature/token-refresh.
Maria S.: Scanner output:
```
rule: sqli-detection
severity: HIGH
file: services/auth/src/db/session_store.go:112
snippet: db.Query("SELECT ... WHERE id = "+userInput)
```
Ajay P.: Ugh. Can you drop the PR and the exact trace? Also did the pipeline run with ephemeral DB creds or redwood-ci-service-account?
Maria S.: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inc/auth/pull/482
Trace shows it came from `session_store.go:112` when `GetSession` concatenates user-controlled `session_id`.
Eli D.: Oncall checklist: 1) Confirm exploitability 2) Collect evidence bundle (scanner output + provenance) 3) Isolate failing commit (revert/canary) 4) Escalate to owning team and PSIRT if confirmed. :white_check_mark:
Tess: For evidence bundle — use `scripts/collect-scan-evidence.sh` (internal) to grab artifact, raw scanner output, and CI metadata. Example:
```
./scripts/collect-scan-evidence.sh --job=ci/sast --run=98317 --output=/tmp/evidence.tar.gz
```
Maria S.: Quick KMS note: to let sec oncall decrypt the artifact we need an ephemeral KMS grant for `redwood-ci-scanner@` service account. Ops, can you grant `kms:Decrypt` to `sec-oncall` for the artifact key? Prefer short TTL.
Ajay P.: Proposed RBAC change: add temporary binding in authz project via:
```
resource: projects/redwood-prod/cryptoKeys/artifact-key
member: serviceAccount:sec-oncall@redwood.com
role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
condition: title: \"ephemeral-scan-triage\", expr: \"request.time < timestamp('2026-03-22T00:00:00Z')\"
```
Eli D.: Also record who did the grant in audit logs. Quick bq query to find KMS IAM bindings in last 7 days:
```
SELECT protoPayload.authenticationInfo.principalEmail, timestamp, protoPayload.request.@type
FROM `redwood-logs.cloud.audit_logs_*`
WHERE protoPayload.serviceName = \"cloudkms.googleapis.com\"
AND protoPayload.methodName = \"SetIamPolicy\"
AND timestamp > TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 7 DAY);
```
sec-oncall-bot: :information_source: Evidence bundle uploaded to https://internal.artifacts/redwood/evidence/98317.tar.gz — grant request queued.
Maria S.: Thanks — I'll triage exploitability now and loop back. If confirmed, we follow PSIRT per runbook and open incident ticket.
Ajay P.: Keep us posted. If exploitability is high, enable short-term canary rollback on that service and apply code fix PR.
